notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.138 - Bug Fixes and Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
Hello all. This week our game was released. Now the game starts its early access. We are glad that you can experience our game!
In order to improve the game and discover its potentials, we want to invite everyone to join the discussion.
Please let us know the problems and give us your opinion on.
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/EXBPrnpjtZ
============================================

Following are the details of this update:
[h3]Bug fix[/h3]
- Fixed the problem that the enemy cannot be killed after using skills.
- Fixed the problem of wrong building layers in level 5.
- Fixed the problem of missing English translation of some hints and descriptive text.
- Removed the skill talent and its branch talent because the skill "Thunder" has no practical effect. It will be added in the next version update. Very sorry for the confusion.

[h3]Balance adjustment[/h3]
- Adjusted monster strength. This is to make the monsters behave more as expected in the battle.
- Adjusted gold mine building cost. This is to speed up the pace of the game. Also all resource site upgrade costs have been slightly reduced.
